proves: glpsol --check translates the model file with the data file and generates the problem without error (run by the compile wrapper)
at the b1 point the parsed data file holds exactly the values of the runner's own tables B1_Output_Params/<scenario> (the data file is the compiled tables)

every fuel with SpecifiedAnnualDemand or AccumulatedAnnualDemand above 0 is reachable from a technology mode with no input fuel; WARN when a cycle of unreachable fuels lies upstream (a cycle with gains could make fuel from nothing)

every fuel a technology takes as input has a producer; FAIL when the consumer has an activity lower limit and needs the fuel in every mode; WARN otherwise (a minimum capacity alone does not force activity)
a fuel produced but neither demanded nor used nor tagged for renewables or reserve margin (a dead end)
a technology with an activity lower limit whose whole input chain has largest activity 0 upstream (no mode of it can run); WARN when a cycle lies upstream
constraints: AAC2 AAC3 CAa4 CAb1 TCC1 EBb4

proves: no duplicate key in a parameter block, no repeated block with data, no value for an element missing from its set, no parameter missing from the model file

every technology has OperationalLife and CapacityToActivityUnit (WARN when only the declared default applies; FAIL with no default); CapacityFactor and AvailabilityFactor in [0 1]; YearSplit sums to 1 per year; SpecifiedDemandProfile sums to 1 per demanded fuel and year
each scenario the model configuration lists has its compiled folder B1_Output_Params/<scenario> and its data file (at the final point: each Stage 3 scenario has its FINAL data file)
TotalAnnualMinCapacity at most TotalAnnualMaxCapacity
TotalAnnualMinCapacityInvestment at most TotalAnnualMaxCapacityInvestment
activity lower limit at most activity upper limit
model period lower limit at most model period upper limit; sum of annual lower limits at most the model period upper limit
ResidualCapacity at most TotalAnnualMaxCapacity (new capacity is never negative)
residual capacity plus the minimum investments still within their operational life at most maximum capacity
minimum capacity at most residual capacity plus the maximum investments still within their operational life

activity lower limit at most the most activity the reachable capacity allows: min(max capacity; residual plus reachable investments) x sum(CapacityFactor x YearSplit) x min(AvailabilityFactor; 1) x CapacityToActivityUnit; model period lower limit at most the sum of those over the period
constraints: CAa4_Constraint_Capacity CAb1_PlannedMaintenance CAa1 CAa2 TCC1 NCC1 AAC3 TAC3

proves: after pushing limits along the chain (a producer's largest activity falls to what its inputs can deliver; a producer's least activity rises when the others at their largest cannot cover the requirement) the least requirement of a fuel exceeds the most its producers can supply in a year or (fuels with a demand profile) in a time slice; WARN per time slice for fuels linked to a storage
constraints: EBa11_EnergyBalanceEachTS5 EBb4_EnergyBalanceEachYear4 EQ_SpecifiedDemand CAa4 CAb1 AAC2 AAC3

proves: the least emissions the tightened activities allow (single-output producers of a fuel filled lowest emission per unit first; others at their least activity times their smallest ratio; exogenous emissions added) exceed AnnualEmissionLimit
constraints: E1 E2 E6 E8_AnnualEmissionsLimit plus the P1 constraints

proves: REMinProductionTarget times the least production of tagged fuels exceeds the largest production of tagged technologies
ReserveMargin times the least production rate of tagged fuels in a time slice exceeds the largest tagged capacity times CapacityToActivityUnit
a value a merged job wrote (value_register.csv: before -> after) is not replaced in the compiled file of a scenario that should carry it: the compiled cell still holds the before value
constraints: none (standard: registered values reach the solver)

proves: every EmissionsPenalty is 0 except models listed in thresholds.csv with the reason
constraints: E3 E4 E5 (objective; the standard forbids invisible penalties)

proves: every rule output the pipeline reads (_STAGE1_OUTPUT/RENEWABLE_TARGETS.csv; shares of the Stage 1 and Stage 2 controllers; REMinProductionTarget in the data file) lies in [0 1]
inputs of years up to the history cut-off are identical across the scenarios of a model; WARN at the b1 point for models whose history the pipeline equalises later (scenario_rules.py)
an input that differs between BAU and a policy scenario has a row in the scenario difference register of the latest merged job
constraints: none (rule of 21 November: only policy measures differ)

proves: a published target loaded into a Tech_Adoption row is written only as a minimum (no Max in Restriction_Type)
constraints: AAC2 (rule of 21 November: published targets are minimums held after their year)

proves: every limit value different from its default has an origin (register row; workbook location; A2 compiled table; stage rule); values with none are UNTRACED (provenance.csv)
a technology with no input fuel and no limit on activity or capacity and zero capital and variable cost (a free unlimited source)
year-to-year change of energy emissions or generation or new capacity above the thresholds
each loaded renewable share target (held after its year) and each energy emission reduction against BAU is met within tolerance
results for history years identical across scenarios within tolerance
